|upnp = }} ==Issues fixed== ===Game fails to launch on MacOS=== {{Fixbox|description= Open terminal and run the command 'sudo chown -v “$USER” ~/.config' then restart your computer. This should correct the ownership of a folder that Stardew Valley needs to write under allowing the game to launch properly.{{Refurl|url=https://www.stardewvalley.net/stardew-valley-troubleshooting-guide/|title=Stardew Valley Troubleshooting Guide|date=2025-09-14}}}} ===Native Linux version fails to launch (Steam version){{Refcheck|user=emkay|date=2026-01-08|comment=}}=== {{Fixbox|description= In Steam, open the 'Properties' of the games entry, go to the 'Compatibility' tab, and select 'Legacy runtime 1.0' in the drop-down list.}} ===Native Linux version stuck on "Connecting to online services' in Co-Op (Online) option{{Refurl|url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/stuck-on-connecting-to-online-services-screen-when-trying-to-play-co-op.37195/|title=Linux Stuck on "Connecting to online services" screen when trying to play co-op|date=2026-01-08}}=== {{Fixbox|description= 1.The package 'execstack' needs to be installed from your distributions repository. Fedora: sudo dnf install execstack Ubuntu: sudo apt install execstack Arch: yay -S execstack 2. Navigate to the Stardew Valley folder: i.e '' '''/home/user/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/''' '' Then, in a terminal, run the following command: execstack -c libGalaxy64.so && execstack -c libGalaxyCSharpGlue.so.}} ==Other information== ===AI usage=== {{AI usage |code = |2d graphics = |3d graphics = |animation = |audio = |speech = |video = |text = |localization = |concept = }} {{ii}} Developer Eric "ConcernedApe" Barone has stated publicly that he will not use AI for any creative work on Stardew Valley or its follow-up.{{Refurl|url=https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2026/05/youre-offloading-creativity-to-an-algorithm-stardew-valley-creator-stands-firm-against-ai|title="You're Offloading Creativity To An Algorithm" - Stardew Valley Creator Stands Firm Against AI|date=2026-05-14}} ===API=== {{API |direct3d versions = 9.0c |direct3d notes = |directdraw versions = |directdraw notes = |opengl versions = 2.0 |opengl notes = |glide versions = |glide notes = |software mode = |software mode notes = |mantle support = |mantle support notes = |metal support = |metal support notes = |vulkan versions = |vulkan notes = |dos modes = |dos modes notes = |shader model versions = 3.0 |shader model notes = |windows 32-bit exe = true |windows 64-bit exe = true |windows arm app = unknown |windows exe notes = The legacy compatibility version on Steam is 32-bit. |mac os x powerpc app = unknown |macos intel 32-bit app = unknown |macos intel 64-bit app = true |macos arm app = unknown |macos app notes = |linux 32-bit executable= unknown |linux 64-bit executable= true |linux arm app = hackable |linux executable notes = ARM support: see [https://github.com/a9ix/ValleyCore ValleyCore] }} ===[https://smapi.io/ SMAPI]=== The mod loader for '''Stardew Valley'''. Required for most types of mod. {{++}} Easy to install and use. {{ii}} Compatible with Linux/Mac/Windows. Works fine with GOG and Steam achievements. ===[https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/470174-content-patcher Content Patcher]=== Loads content packs that change the game's data, images, and maps without replacing XNB files and make changes dynamically based on many in-game details. {{++}} Great for easy mod creation.
